metadata.Title: Personal Shield and Pricing | Toza
metadata.Description: Personal Shield ₪14,000 for one person. Inner Circle Shield from ₪42,000 for four. Compare devices, security keys and work time. Assessment ₪3,600. VAT included.
metadata.Social description: See what Toza will assess, harden and teach: your personal threat model, device and account changes, supplied security keys and practical OpSec training.

creditNotes.text: Start with a separate ₪3,600 Private Exposure Assessment for the initial client. Its fee counts toward the selected full engagement only if that engagement begins within 14 days of completion of the initial service. Booking alone does not qualify. The credit applies once per group engagement.
